messages: I got another request from #p406#. #p408#, the owner of the weapon shop, is quite the unusual foodie--he wants to cook up a special dish of Evil Eye Tail Stew. He needs me to hunt #b50 #o23#s#k and bring back #b30 #t4000022#s#k. Sounds like he'll be eating well for a while! Once I've gotten everything, I should bring it all back to #b#p406##k.

I delivered what #p408# asked for and got a pair of shoes in return. Now... #p408# doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. After helping out the people in this town, I feel like I've really become close with them!
name: Cutthroat Manny's Request
